subject: Money
title: Salt as Salary
description: A fast breakdown of Salt as Salary for builders.

hook.text: Roman soldiers were paid in salt. The word 'salary' comes from salarium—salt money.

buildup.text: Salt preserved food in a world without refrigeration. It was essential, portable, and divisible.

discovery.text: Salt roads crisscrossed the ancient world. Cities grew where salt was traded. It shaped geography.

twist.text: Some historians doubt the salary story. But salt taxes funded empires from China to France.

climax.text: Salt shows that money can be anything people need badly enough. Necessity creates value.

punchline.text: Worth your salt meant worth your pay.

quiz.question: What does the word 'salary' derive from?
